identity.title: An ALMA spectroscopic survey of the Planck high-redshift object PLCK G073.4−57.5 confirms two protoclusters

paper_type_evidence.quote: We used ALMA Band 4 spectral scans to search for , , and Ci(1–0) line emission, targeting eight red Herschel-SPIRE sources in the field, as well as four bright SCUBA-2 sources.

redshift_or_distance.value: structures at <z> = 1.53 and <z> = 2.31; SCUBA-2 galaxies at z = 2.61

evidence.quote: Eleven of these galaxies are SPIRE-selected and lie in two structures at $\langle z \rangle\,{=}\,1.53$ and $\langle z \rangle\,{=}\,2.31$

distance_source.value: spectroscopic redshifts from ALMA CO/Ci lines (this work)

evidence.quote: We find 15 emission lines in 13 galaxies, and using existing photometry information, we determined the spectroscopic redshift of all 13 galaxies.

question.value: What is the redshift distribution of the galaxies in the Planck-selected field G073, are the two suspected structures (z~1.5 and z~2) real protoclusters, and what are their gas and star-formation properties?

evidence.quote: Characterizing the full redshift distribution of the galaxies within G073 is needed in order to better understand this representative example of Planck-selected objects, and connect them to the emergence of galaxy clusters.
(Project ID 2018.1.00562.S, PI R. Hill)
The ALMA data can be found under the two programmes 2013.1.01173.S (PI: R. Kneissl) and 2018.1.00562.S (PI: R. Hill).

bands.value: Band 4 (2.1 mm; Cycle 6) plus Band 6 (1.3 mm; Cycle 2, from Kneissl+19)

evidence.quote: G073 was observed for 0.4 hours in Band 6 using the standard Band 6 tuning centred at about 1.3 mm.

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: four 1.78 GHz spectral windows with 15.6 MHz channels, centred at 136.1, 138.1, 148.1, 150.1 GHz; LSB around 136 GHz, USB around 149 GHz

evidence.quote: The Band 4 spectral set-up used four 1.78-GHz-wide continuum spectral windows (with channel widths of 15.6 MHz) around the central frequency of 143.1 GHz (2.1 mm).
so we tuned our Band 4 observations to centre the redshifted CO(3–2) line around 136 GHz in the lower sideband (LSB).
The upper sideband (USB) was centred around 149 GHz in order to search for Ci(1–0) in the $z\,{\approx}\,2$ structure

configurations.value: C-5 array configuration, 45–48 antennas, baselines 15–1400 m

evidence.quote: 45–48 antennas were available in the nominal C-5 array configuration with baseline lengths of 15–1400 m.

angular_resolution.value: about 0.65'' x 0.55'' (LSB) and 0.58'' x 0.50'' (USB), natural weighting

evidence.quote: This achieved synthesized beam sizes (using natural weighting) of around 0.65$''$ ${\times}$ 0.55$''$ full width at half maximum (FWHM) in the lower side band and 0.58$''$ ${\times}$ 0.50$''$ in the USB.

sensitivity.value: continuum 15–20 uJy/beam in each of 12 pointings

evidence.quote: The central continuum sensitivity in each of the 12 pointings was approximately 15–20 $\mu$Jy beam$^{-1}$.
We received in total 3.23 hours of on-source observing time on G073 with ALMA in Cycle 6
taken in four executions on 2018 4, 8, 11, and 12 November.
